wafProbeResult: Cloudflare PASSIVE for any real-browser UA (Chrome desktop, iPhone Safari, no-UA empty) -> 200 on homepage, /shop/, /shop/page/N/, /wp-json/wp/v2/product. ACTIVE only for explicit bot tokens (curl/* default UA, Googlebot UA) -> 403. R1 claim of 'active CF' was an artifact of bot-UA + parallel curl, not WAF severity for production traffic. Production crawler USER_AGENTS pool (Chrome 120, Safari 17.2, Firefox 121, Edge 120 — http-client.ts:9-14) all pass.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of 6 chosen top-level product_cat counts = 6173. Global product count = 5851 (x-wp-total). Excess of 322 = product overlap: high-value-optics products are ALSO tagged with sights-optics (verified: holosun-he507c product_cat=[16854,391,165]). iron-sights products are tagged with accessories+iron-sights (verified: troy-m4-front-sight product_cat=[40,396,449,16962,16880]). R1's claim that sights-optics is parent of high-value-optics+iron-sights is FALSE: all three have parent=0 (verified via /wp-json/wp/v2/product_cat?slug=... query). Uncategorized gap ~2 products. DB's 6 catalogUrls choice = ~260 pages (firearms 88 + ammunition 81 + accessories 52 + sights-optics 25 + high-value-optics 12 + iron-sights 2) vs single /shop/ = 244 pages; per-category costs 16 extra pages but enables independent token allocation per catalog-crawler.ts:378.

auditNotes.probeMethod: Adversarial R2: each R1 divergence re-tested with a method different from R1's WHY hypothesis. Verdict counts below.

r2Verdicts.adapterType: DB wins (generic-retail). adapter-registry.ts:118 is sole routing key. dataFlow.steps[] is unconsumed metadata — verified via grep over backend/src/: no consumer exists. DB's intentional override (WC-platform-routed-via-generic-retail) stands. Candidate followed skill-table verbatim.
r2Verdicts.wafType: DB wins (cloudflare-passive). R1's 'active' verdict was an artifact of bot-UA / curl-default-UA + parallel-burst probes. Re-tested live with full UA matrix: Chrome desktop, iPhone Safari, no-UA, all = 200 on /shop/ and /wp-json/wp/v2/product. Bot UAs (curl/X.Y.Z, Googlebot) get 403, but that's Bot Fight Mode (orthogonal to WAF severity for real-browser traffic). Production USER_AGENTS pool (http-client.ts:9-14) all pass.
r2Verdicts.needsPlaywright: DB wins (false). Follows from wafType=passive. Verified plain axios with production-default UA returns 200 on all crawl-critical paths (/shop/, /shop/page/244/, /wp-json/wp/v2/product, /product-category/firearms/). No Playwright needed for routine crawl.
r2Verdicts.userAgentOverride: DB wins (null/absent). R1 added iPhone Safari override based on (incorrect) active-CF verdict. With production UAs passing, no override is needed.
r2Verdicts.expectedProductCount: Both wrong; B4R2 = 5851 (live x-wp-total 2026-05-19). DB's 5741 stale by 42 days, R1's 5846 stale by ~hours (site grew 5 in the interim).
r2Verdicts.catalogUrls: DB wins (6 per-category URLs). Both candidate's ['/shop/'] and DB's 6 per-cat URLs are consumed at runtime (generic-retail.ts:198 reads profile.catalogUrls). Operator chose 6 to enable independent token-budget allocation per URL at catalog-crawler.ts:378 (one rate-limited category doesn't block others). Single /shop/ = 244 pages (simpler) vs 6 per-cat = ~260 pages (16-page overhead, but scheduling fairness). DB's choice is more production-aware. R1 also misread hierarchy: sights-optics, high-value-optics, iron-sights are SIBLINGS (all parent=0), not parent-child as R1 implied.
r2Verdicts.crawlers.maintain.verifyMethod: DB wins (wp-rest). Custom verifyBehavior split: WP REST for title/slug/thumbnail identity + HTML /product/{slug}/ for price/stock enrichment. More efficient than full per-product detail-page Playwright fetch. R1 fell back to detail-page because Store API is CF-blocked, but missed that WP REST core is open.
r2Verdicts.sortParam: Equivalent; DB explicit form preferred (?orderby=date&order=desc). WC default for orderby=date is desc, but DB's explicit form is safer against future WC version changes.
r2Verdicts.paginationPattern.template: Equivalent; DB form preferred (/page/{N} no trailing slash). Runtime tolerant per catalog-crawler.ts:121-125.
